description: Controlled synthetic benchmark for belief updating and decision risk under evolving personal preferences.

rai:dataLimitations: Synthetic structured evidence; binary preference domains; generator-defined transition dynamics; not validated for natural-language extraction, real human populations, or frontier-model performance. Not recommended as the sole evidence for deployment decisions.
rai:dataBiases: Domain selection, source reliabilities, temporal processes, and query schedules are designed by the benchmark authors and may overrepresent cleanly factorized preference dynamics compared with natural interaction.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No real-person data, demographic attributes, medical records, political/religious beliefs, or direct identifiers are included. User identifiers are synthetic.
rai:dataUseCases: Established use: controlled evaluation of state tracking, calibration, risk-coverage, and decision utility under known evolving preferences. Not established: natural-language understanding, human-population validity, fairness, production safety, or real-user personalization quality.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Potential positive use includes more rigorous evaluation of personal-agent memory and uncertainty. Misuse could encourage persistent profiling or overconfident automated action if synthetic results are overgeneralized; the release therefore documents limitations and emphasizes calibration, user control, and permission boundaries.
